method: Viewed all grouped boards, all three 64px comparison pages, the alpha checker board and pavement/reference comparison

observations.pm_flat_style: Volumetric rendering, embossed highlights and material texture removed; schematic frontal/profile symbols with beige/ochre fills
observations.native_style_remaining_judgment: Contours are bolder than the provided native references; approval required rather than claiming exact native fidelity
observations.transparency: Real alpha confirmed; manually inspected cutouts in flasks, wheels, sieve, factory windows and furnace around the flame
observations.road_technology: Gray fan-arranged cobblestones from user photograph; top-view patch, no substrate cross-section or additional tool
observations.native_building: Actual vanilla railway image bound directly, no custom repaint or override
observations.small_sizes: Reviewed 32/48/64px on light and dark backgrounds; more intricate machinery loses fine detail at 32px, so 64px comparisons remain available
